blocks.text: Hum mukhtalif qism ki waves (lehrein) se khoob waqif hain, jaise samandar ki pani ki lehrein aur barish ke qatron se thehre hue talab par bante gol ripples. Jab koi musician guitar ka taar chherta hai to hawa mein sound waves paida hoti hain jo hamare kaan tak pohanch kar mausiqi ka ehsas dilati hain. Suraj ki bohat bari energy, jo karoron kilometre door hai, light waves ke zariye Zameen tak muntaqil hoti hai. Yeh chapter mukhtalif qism ki waves ki banawat, phailao (propagation) aur istemalat par baat karta hai.

blocks.title: Wave
blocks.text: Wave ek baqaida khalal (disturbance) ya tabdeeli hai jo energy le kar chalti hai aur source se bahar phailti hai. Misal ke taur par Suraj se Zameen tak energy light waves ki shakal mein muntaqil hoti hai jinhein electromagnetic waves kehte hain, aur yeh khala (vacuum) mein bhi chal sakti hain. Kisi medium mein, albatta, energy baqaida aur baar baar hone wale khalal se muntaqil hoti hai jo medium mein chalte hain aur us ke zarron ko oopar neeche ya aage peeche hilate hain.

Socheye ke talab ke pani mein ek pathar phenka gaya (Fig. 7.1): pathar ek khalal (ripple) paida karta hai jo pani (medium) mein chalta hai, aur pani ke zarre apni hi jagah par oopar neeche hote hain, aur ek dohrata naqsha banta hai jise wave kehte hain jo bahar phailti hai. Wave ke kisi zarre ka displacement us ki aaram ya equilibrium position se kisi muqarrar simt mein faasla hai. Agar displacement ko y-axis par aur energy ke safar ki simt mein faasle ko x-axis par plot karein to waveform milta hai (Fig. 7.2).

items: Amplitude (A): equilibrium position se wave (ya medium ke zarron) ka zyada se zyada displacement.
Frequency (f): fi second oscillations, vibrations ya cycles ki tadaad.
Wavelength (lambda): wave par do lagataar milte julte nuqton ka faasla jo ek hi phase mein hon.
Period (T): wave ko ek oscillation ya cycle poora karne mein lagne wala waqt; yeh frequency ka ulat (reciprocal) hai, T = 1/f.
Speed (v): wave ke chalne ki raftar. Agar wave ka crest ek period T mein ek wavelength lambda chale to speed v = lambda/T, aur chunke 1/T = f, v = f lambda ... (7.1).
Phase (theta): diye gaye waqt par wave par kisi nuqte ki nisbati position.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: sine waveform, wavelength aur amplitude ke nishan aur v = f lambda ke saath. Oopar darmiyan: transverse wave aur compressions aur rarefactions ki longitudinal qatar, chaar qism ki waves ke saath. Oopar daen: ek phase mein do waves ka jama hona aur ulat phase mein do waves ka khatam hona. Neeche baen: ek generator se chalne wale do speakers, microphone ka nuqta aur CRO, interference ki sharait aur Examples 7.1 aur 7.2 ke saath. Neeche daen: noise aur anti-noise ka khatam hona.
blocks.caption: Waves: parameters, aqsam, superposition aur interference (Figures 7.1 se 7.5 aur topics 7.1 se 7.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Wave energy ko bahar le jati hai jabke medium ke zarre sirf apni aaram ki jagah ke gird jhoolte hain; us ka amplitude sab se bara displacement, wavelength ek phase wale padosi nuqton ka faasla, frequency fi second oscillations, aur speed frequency zarb wavelength hai. Transverse wave mein zarre safar ki simt ke aar paar aur longitudinal wave mein us ke saath saath, compressions aur rarefactions mein, hilte hain. Jab waves milti hain to un ke displacements jama hote hain: ek phase mein barabar waves dugna displacement deti hain, ulat phase mein barabar waves koi nahi. Ek generator se chalne wale do speakers coherent hain, to un ke saamne microphone wahan buland awaz pata hai jahan path difference wavelengths ka poora adad ho aur wahan dheemi jahan aadhi wavelengths ka taaq (odd) adad ho. Noise-cancelling headphones noise ki ulat phase wali naqal chalate hain ta ke dono khatam ho jayein.

blocks.title: Transverse aur longitudinal waves
blocks.text: Waves ki do bari aqsam hain, transverse aur longitudinal (Fig. 7.3). Transverse wave woh hai jis mein zarron ki vibrations wave ki energy ke safar ki simt ke amudi (right angles par) hon. Longitudinal wave woh hai jis mein zarron ki vibration ki simt wave ki energy ke safar ki simt ke saath, ya mutawazi (parallel), ho.

blocks.prompt: Longitudinal aur transverse waves mein farq bataiye (short question 7.4), aur longitudinal wave ke compressions aur rarefactions ka transverse wave ke crests aur troughs se muwazna kijiye (constructed response 7.3).
blocks.explanation: Transverse wave mein zarre energy ke safar ki simt ke amudi hilte hain (taar par wave, light); longitudinal wave mein us ke saath saath (hawa mein sound). Compressions, jahan zarre ghane hain aur dabao sab se zyada, crests ka kirdar ada karte hain, aur rarefactions, jahan zarre phaile hain aur dabao sab se kam, troughs ka; dono mein wavelength ek se agle ek jaise hisse tak ka faasla hai.

items: Wave source se energy le jane wala baqaida khalal hai; medium mein zarre sirf jhoolte hain (talab ke ripples).

Parameters: amplitude A, frequency f, wavelength lambda, period T = 1/f, speed v = lambda/T = f lambda (7.1), phase. Aqsam: mechanical, electromagnetic, quantum, surface; transverse (vibration safar ki simt ke aar paar) aur longitudinal (us ke saath).
